 Daily Markets Briefing: STI down 0.36%; Top stock is Mapletree Logistics Trust
 Mapletree Logistics Trust is the top stock with a 2.80% increase. 
 The Straits Times Index (STI) closed at 5,376.74, down 0.36% on Friday, 30 October at 5:21 p.m.
 Mapletree Logistics Trust was the most active stock, followed by Thai Beverage Public Company Limited (+2.41%) and City Developments Ltd (+2.23%)
 Wilmar International Limited and SGX were at the foot.
